222-527-4927-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4927-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1445-4871-7396-8250.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-7396-8250.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

522-2438--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1445-2366-4826-6413-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2366-4826-6413-7824.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

943-2203-2597-4235-5621.easyPrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Guildless Commons.
943-2203-2597-4235-5621.description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding two mana.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding two additional mana.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Arid Archway.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Arid Archway.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-5662-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reyhan.
When Reyhan dies, its persist ability and innate ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reyhan from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the innate trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on a creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

661-3685-4659-7692.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Shuri. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-2851-6972.description:
Activate Death Cultist by sacrificing it.
When Death Cultist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Death Cultist ability.
Repeat.

4496-4699-5220-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3175-5147-7424.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

240-997-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

4067-4306-6281-7327.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 3.
4067-4306-6281-7327.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ragamuffin Raptor.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Ragamuffin Raptor that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Ragamuffin Raptor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ragamuffin Raptor from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

579-1753-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-1753-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

628-997-6935.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3901-4083-6899.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Wrathful Red Dragon.
Wrathful Red Dragon is indestructible.
3901-4083-6899.description:
Deal damage to Wrathful Red Dragon.
Wrathful Red Dragon and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Wrathful Red Dragon trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Wrathful Red Dragon instead of you due to With Great Power....
Repeat from step 2.

803-3967-4338.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Arcane Adaptation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

3527-4567.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power.
3527-4567.description:
Activate Spatial Binding by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

1563-2079-2457-2557.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

698-2060-2433-2609.manaNeeded: {W} if Crystalline Crawler doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
698-2060-2433-2609.easyPrerequisites: Will, Scion of Peace does not have summoning sickness.
698-2060-2433-2609.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast this turn to cost at least {3} less.
If Crystalline Crawler has a +1/+1 counter on it, activate it by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Rosie Cotton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-3767-3918-4452.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with "You don't lose the game due to having 0 or less life"

2656-2935--84.description:
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Resolve all Ethereal Champion abilities.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each opponent's life total to become 0.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 life.

1887-1912-2060-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1887-1912-2060-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

56-1417-4976-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-1417-4976-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Bridge from Below and Open the Graves trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-1417-4976-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

933-1061-1576.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
933-1061-1576.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
933-1061-1576.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering its first ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

235-4179-5438.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Explosive Singularity by paying at most {8}{R}{R}, dealing 10 damage to any creature.
Imodane triggers, giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

90-262-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature with power 1 or greater that does not have summoning sickness.
"Elemental" chosen with Engineered Plague.
90-262-2178.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
The Elemental(s) enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Elemental(s) die, the creature with Thornbite Staff attached triggers that many times, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1462-2929-3756.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

3317-3389-4050-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
3317-3389-4050-4772.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, attaching it to any creature you control.
Flickering Ward enters the battlefield, triggering Historian's Boon's first ability, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature with Flickering Ward attached and a Soldier token, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
